boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 143 is a dual-board feeder — an upper placement grid drains through a purple phase counter into a lower yellow-bordered frame whose central number ticks from `17` downward. The phase counter gates the speed: each milestone unlocks the next batch of pieces for transfer. Push the right-side blocks before the counter reaches its midpoint and the lower frame jams with pieces arriving out of order.
landmarks: Block Out Level 143 is a dual-board feeder — an upper placement grid drains through a purple phase counter into a lower yellow-bordered frame whose central number ticks from `17` downward.
The phase counter gates the speed: each milestone unlocks the next batch of pieces for transfer.
Push the right-side blocks before the counter reaches its midpoint and the lower frame jams with pieces arriving out of order.

quickTips: Clear the middle 2/1 strip before spending the right-rail 9 counter.
Watch the phase box — it must reach 07 before the lower 7 tile can be zeroed.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top red/green row in the upper grid using the left inventory blue pieces.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Feed the upper exits through the purple phase box as it cycles 01 → 04.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Spend the right-rail 4/2/9 counters by routing blocks down the right arrow buttons.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Break the middle 2/1 strip once the lower frame drops from 17 toward 7.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining blue clusters in the upper grid through the 07 phase.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Route the lower-frame scraps through the green down-arrow and right-arrow lanes.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Zero the lower 7 tile and clear the last upper scraps for the BLOW OUT! finish.

failurePoints: Spending the right-rail 9 before the 2 tile clears, blocking the lower green down-arrow.
Feeding the upper grid before the phase box reaches 04, wasting blocks in the middle strip.
